svg.title: DEEP BLUE GRID Web canonical CIC surface, controls, telegraphs and damage-layer reference
svg.desc: Unity Android implementation reference derived from app/globals.css and app/game/Renderer.ts. It records the canonical palette, radar surface, every command button state, telegraph hierarchy, damage states, animation periods and board draw order.

g.text: DEEP BLUE GRID // WEB CANONICAL VISUAL TARGET
UNITY ANDROID PORT — CIC SURFACE / COMMAND MATERIAL / TELEGRAPH / DAMAGE COMPOSITING
REFERENCE SCALE ONLY — RETAIN RELATIVE RATIOS AT ANY DPI
FONT: COURIER NEW → YU GOTHIC UI → MONOSPACE
CANVAS 1:1 · WEB MAX 570 PX · MARGIN 7.5% · DEVICE PIXEL RATIO CAPPED AT 2
Do not replace it with one blue panel
or a flat grid texture. Global scanline,

g.aria-label: Command button material and state reference

g.text: HOVER · visual only, no geometry shift
UNITY: NINE-SLICE THE FRAME. KEEP INNER 2 PX RECESS + BOTTOM EXTRUSION; DO NOT USE A FLAT COLOR RECT.
TEXT IS A SIGNAL LAYER, NOT A TOAST
自軍攻撃：敵軍海域を表示
LEFT 4 PX = STATE COLOR · BASELINE STATUS IS ALWAYS VISIBLE
strip min-height 47 px · inner shadow 20 px
TURN FLASH · FULL SCREEN VEIL #06131DAA · 1.05 s
敵に自軍反応を捕捉されました
HOSTILE: RED + .42 s STEPPED INNER LOCK FRAME
敵に識別されました：航空母艦
HOSTILE VITAL WARNING · PERSIST UNTIL REVIEW CONFIRM
特殊潜水艦、接触を断つ
戦況を記録し、次の攻撃へ移行
STICKY BOTTOM · SAFE AREA + 5 PX · Z 21
IDENTIFICATION 0–14% IN / 14–75% HOLD / OUT · DIVE 0–12% IN / 12–76% HOLD / OUT
SCREEN SHAKE .28 s ONLY: (+4,-2) → (-5,+3) → (+3,+2) → ORIGIN. NEVER ACCUMULATE OFFSET.
NO EXPLOSION SPRITE · NO CRATER · NO FULL-CELL RED FILL
SHIP DAMAGE POINT: radius .12c · HIT/SUNK STAR: outer .27c, inner .16c · INTACT VITAL: r .17c
HIT VITAL: r .31c, stroke max(1 px, .045c) · IDENTIFICATION: r .34c, stroke max(1.5 px, .045c)
HIT/SUNK PULSE: alpha .70 + .25 sin(t×8) · HIT VITAL: alpha .78 + .20 sin(t×7) · IDENT: .82 + .16 sin(t×5)
Do not swap the hull cell for a generic damage icon. Draw hull, structural dot, tactical mark, then vital/ID.
BOARD DRAW ORDER — EXACT WEB COMPOSITING CONTRACT
LOWEST Z AT LEFT · HIGHEST Z AT RIGHT
CIC atmosphere remains visible under every phase; overlays do not erase scanline/noise identity.
Buttons show recess, border, lower extrusion and state color; flat Material color alone is not accepted.
Telegraphs use their defined screen position and timing. Friendly cyan, review amber, hostile danger red.
A hit never deletes the ship silhouette: structural dot + pulsing tactical star are composited over the hull.
Critical hit outline is above HIT; identification is above critical; sinking recolors hull and marks the complete footprint.
Judge the result from an actual portrait screenshot and a 1920×1080 landscape screenshot, not Scene view alone.
